name: mineguard-ai
description: MineGuard AI — Industrial Conveyor Condition Monitoring & Predictive Safety Platform (SIH 26008)

scripts.build: npm --prefix mineguard-dashboard run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('mineguard-dashboard/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); console.log('✓ Production build assets compiled to dist/');"
scripts.build:vanilla: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('code.html', 'dist/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('config.js', 'dist/config.js'); fs.copyFileSync('dashboard.js', 'dist/dashboard.js'); fs.copyFileSync('telemetryConfig.js', 'dist/telemetryConfig.js'); console.log('✓ Vanilla build assets compiled to dist/');"

author: MineGuard Engineering Team (SIH 26008)
